baseline.premature_destruction: GDB traced QScreen::~QScreen through shiboken6 and Python delete_garbage during generation-zero collection, before the next dialog constructor faulted.
baseline.deterministic_guard: Constructing Annotate settings, retaining app.primaryScreen(), then delivering dialog.deleteLater() invalidated the retained screen wrapper. The assertion failed before the change.

change.lookup: Static QGuiApplication.screenAt at the visible anchor center, with primaryScreen fallback. Hidden children use their parent. Real QWidget/QWindow screen() accessors are avoided.

native_debugger_replays.screen_destruction: Only after the tests, through QWindowSystemInterface::handleScreenRemoved at application shutdown; no collection-driven QScreen destructor.

limits: Local acceptance used Linux offscreen Qt; physical multi-monitor placement was not exercised.
The protected full CI run predates this fix; no full-suite green claim.
Existing non-Qt screen-provider stand-ins remain supported.
